summary: The appellants, former Overseers/Surveyor Draughtsmen in the General Reserve Engineer Force (GREF), challenged the denial of promotion to Superintendent BR Grade-I and Assistant Engineer posts under GREF Rules, 1982. They held a Diploma in Draughtsman Estimating and Design (DED) from CME Pune, claiming equivalence to a Diploma in Civil Engineering, the prescribed qualification. The High Court rejected their plea, holding the AICTE notification did not equate DED to a civil engineering diploma, and relied on a prior judgment inapplicable to their case. This Court examined Rule 11 of GREF Rules, 1982, which mandates a 'recognized degree in Civil Engineering' for promotion. The appellants lacked this qualification. While juniors with civil engineering diplomas were promoted, the Court found no legal basis to equate DED with a civil engineering degree. The appellants' contention of discrimination failed as the qualification requirement was non-negotiable. The appeal was dismissed, upholding the denial of promotion but noting the High Court's grant of a higher pay scale was unchallenged.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 309 of the Constitution of India
General Reserve Engineer Force Group ‘C’ and Group ‘D’ Recruitment Rules, 1982, Rule 11
